intent_type.description: The declared intent. Every value but `unknown` is one of the Core's canonical intents or a synonym of one (risk_engine::canonical_intent). `withdraw`, `claim`, `burn` and `configure` (and `close` beyond the token and DCA programs) describe only the instructions a grounded grant names (intent_grants), when the transaction's own accounts show the operation is the signer's own; anything else they label is refused.

confidence_of_parse.description: The AI Layer's own confidence in its parse. Accepted, refused outside [0, 1], NOT recorded on the audit trail, and deliberately never read by any scoring path — an AI that is confidently wrong must not be worth more than one that is honestly unsure. NOT a verification confidence score, and not an input to one.
